# TrailSnag brand kit

Every file here is generated by `pnpm brand` (`scripts/build-brand.mjs`) from the
same mark constant the site renders, so the kit cannot drift from the product.
**Do not edit these files by hand** — edit the source and regenerate.

Served from the site, so a file can be linked rather than attached:
`https://trailsnag.com/brand/svg/trailsnag-lockup-ink.svg`

## What to send someone

| They asked for | Send |
|---|---|
| "your logo" | `svg/trailsnag-lockup-ink.svg` |
| a logo for a dark slide or dark site | `svg/trailsnag-lockup-paper.svg` |
| a PNG because their tool refuses SVG | `png/trailsnag-lockup-ink-1024.png` |
| a square avatar (GitHub, LinkedIn, app listing) | `png/trailsnag-avatar-512.png` |
| a one-colour version for print or engraving | `svg/trailsnag-lockup-mono-black.svg` |
| just the pin (favicon, app tile, map marker) | `svg/trailsnag-mark-ink.svg` |
| the name alone, no pin | `svg/trailsnag-wordmark-ink.svg` |

**Prefer the SVG every time.** It is vector, it stays sharp at any size, and its
text is already converted to outlines — the recipient does not need our font.
The PNGs exist only for tools that reject SVG.

## The three shapes

- **lockup** — the pin and the wordmark together. The default; use it unless
  there is a reason not to.
- **mark** — the Blazed Pin alone. For squares, favicons, and anywhere the name
  is already present in the surrounding text.
- **wordmark** — `TrailSnag.` alone. For tight horizontal bands where the pin
  would have to shrink below legibility.

Plus **avatar**, the square paper tile with the pin, for the many services that
accept only a square.

## The four colourways

| Variant | Use on |
|---|---|
| `ink` | light backgrounds — this is the primary logo |
| `paper` | dark backgrounds; the blaze lightens to hold contrast |
| `mono-black` | one-colour reproduction: engraving, stamps, fax, single-plate print |
| `mono-white` | one-colour reproduction on a dark ground |

PNGs are provided in `ink` and `paper` only. Mono is a print concern, and print
takes vector.

## Rules

**Clear space.** Keep a margin on all sides equal to the height of the `T` —
roughly 45 % of the lockup's total height. Nothing else enters that space.

**Minimum size.** The lockup needs about 120 px of width on screen (30 mm in
print) before the blaze knocked out of the pin stops reading. Below that, use
the mark alone, which holds down to 16 px.

**The period is the snag.** It is the one part that carries paint, and it is
always blaze — never ink, never the accent colour of whatever deck the logo
landed in. In the mono variants it collapses to the single ink colour, which is
the only sanctioned exception.

**The knockout is negative space.** The blaze stripe inside the pin is a hole
showing the background through, not a second-coloured shape. Never fill it.

**Do not** re-typeset the wordmark in another font, stretch or condense any
file, rotate the lockup, add shadows, gradients or outlines, place the `ink`
lockup on a dark background, or rebuild the lockup by putting the mark and the
wordmark together yourself — the spacing is part of the logo.

## Colours

| Token | Hex | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| ink | `#0f1f1a` | the near-black pine the mark and wordmark are drawn in |
| paper | `#f1f4ee` | the fog off-white behind everything |
| blaze | `#cb561f` | the paint, on light surfaces |
| blaze (on dark) | `#e2703a` | the same paint, lifted to hold contrast on dark |
| pine | `#2e5a4c` | supporting green, contours and secondary type |

## Type

The wordmark is **Bricolage Grotesque**, weight 800, letter-spacing -0.03em.
The font is licensed OFL-1.1, which is what permits us to ship these outlines.
You do not need it installed to use the files here.

## Regenerating

```sh
pnpm brand      # rewrites everything in this folder
```

The social card at `public/og.png` is a separate, browser-rendered step, because
a raster social card needs a real font engine: edit `scripts/og-card.html`, open
it at exactly 1200×630 with a device pixel ratio of 2, screenshot the viewport,
and downscale that 2400×1260 capture to 1200×630. Run `pnpm brand` first — the
card embeds the lockup straight out of this folder.
